home.title: Léiw Lux – Learn Luxembourgish
home.description: Léiw Lux is an app for learning Luxembourgish at your own pace: lessons, exercises, daily streaks and a leaderboard with friends.

password.title: Reset your password – Léiw Lux
password.description: Choose a new password for your Léiw Lux account.

home.tagline: Learn Luxembourgish, one day at a time.
home.lead: Lessons and exercises at your own pace, daily streaks to keep you going, and a leaderboard to share with friends.
home.mascot_alt: The Léiw Lux mascot: a crowned lion waving.
home.features_title: What you'll find in the app
home.f_lessons_body: Videos, multiple choice, drag and drop, open questions, vocabulary and grammar: every lesson can be practised in several ways.
home.f_offline_body: Download lessons to study without a connection; your progress syncs afterwards.
home.f_streaks_body: Keep going day after day. Freeze tokens protect your streak if you miss a day.
home.f_friends_body: Follow friends and compare your progress on the leaderboard.
home.f_languages_body: The app is available in French, English, German and Luxembourgish.
home.who_body: For anyone who lives, works or studies in Luxembourg, and anyone who simply likes the language.
